text: dsh-inline-edit 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的原生消息编辑插件，可在聊天消息旁打开编辑器，修改用户消息正文并添加、移除或替换附件。它通过会话界面组件和 Host 接口接入 DSH，支持保留原会话并从编辑位置创建新分支，也支持在当前会话中重新生成最近的主消息；编辑图片和文件时保留附件内容，并提供图片预览、文件引用编辑和取消恢复。适合需要修正提示词、调整上传材料后重新提交的 DSH 用户；无需额外 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-inline-edit lets DSH web users revise a chat message and its attachments, then regenerate in a new branch or the current conversation. It supports image preview and file references. No extra API key or external account is required.
想改一下已经发出的 DSH 消息再重新提交。
能不能修改聊天里的提示词，并从修改处开一个新分支？
我想给之前的消息增删附件后再让模型回答。
怎样在当前会话里改最后一条主消息并重新生成？
I need to edit a sent chat prompt and submit it again.
Can I revise a message and continue in a separate conversation branch?
I want to change a message attachment before regenerating the answer.
dsh-inline-edit 的功能「修改消息正文」：在消息旁打开编辑器修改正文，并取消时恢复原内容；保存后可将修改后的消息重新提交。
dsh-inline-edit 的功能「分支重新生成」：选择分支模式后，插件从目标消息之前的会话边界创建新会话，并提交编辑后的正文与附件，原会话保留。
dsh-inline-edit 的功能「当前会话重新生成」：选择当前模式可替换最近一条符合条件的主消息并在同一会话重新生成；不支持忙碌会话和补充消息。
dsh-inline-edit 的功能「编辑附件与文件引用」：编辑时可以保留或移除原附件、添加文件和图片，并编辑 DSH 识别的文件引用；代码对附件数量与大小设置上限。
DSH 发错消息后，想修改正文和附件再继续对话。
dsh-inline-edit README · dsh-inline-edit：DeepSeek Harness 原生消息编辑插件。点击消息旁的铅笔，在原位置修改文字、添加或移除附件；右下角为「取消」和「发送」。

dsh-inline-edit README · 重新生成方式：打开 **设置 → 消息编辑**。选项自动保存到当前 DSH profile；切换选项不会立即修改已有聊天。

| 方式 | 可编辑范围 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 增加分支（默认） | 支持的历史用户消息、已提交的普通用户插话 | 保留原聊天，从修改的位置另建聊天 |
| 在当前对话重新生成 | **最近一条在空闲时发送、发起任务的主消息** | 保持同一个会话 ID，侧边栏不增加聊天 |

**运行中插入或排队追加的补充消息不属于当前模式的可编辑范围。** 即使后来单独得到回答，也不会变成主消息。这些消息没有原地编辑按钮，后台同样拒绝提交；更早的主消息请使用分支模式。

修改主消息后，**它之后的补充消息和回答一并替换**，按修改后的内容重新生成。先等待任务完成或停止，并处理完待发送队列。DSH 自带的「编辑排队消息」属于未提交输入管理，不受本插件影响。

dsh-inline-edit README · 文字与附件：- 只改文字时保留原附件；只增删附件时文字可以不变。
- 支持文字与附件一起修改，也支持只有附件的消息。
- 纯附件或只有空白正文的消息不显示复制文字按钮；含文字的消息复制完整正文，保留原有空格和换行。
- 编辑框显示原图片和新添加图片的缩略图；点击缩略图使用 DSH 原生图片预览放大，点击背景、关闭按钮或按 Esc 返回编辑，保留草稿和附件。预览读取或加载失败时，仍保留文件名和移除操作。
- 打开编辑、文字增高及增删附件时优先向上展开，取消时保持下方回答的位置；滚动空间不足时按可用空间调整，不覆盖上方消息。
- 多文件选择、拖入、粘贴；取消还原原内容。
- 原有和新添加的普通文件与文字位于同一编辑框，显示为 DSH 原生蓝色文件名标签，不附加删除 X。可在文件前、文件之间和文件后继续输入；选择文件后保留选文件前的光标位置，输入从新标签后继续，无需补空格。
- 普通文件标签可用 Backspace、Delete 或选中后剪切整项移除，撤销可恢复真实附件；发送时保留原附件引用或新文件内容，文件名不混入正文。
- 消息里由 DSH 识别的文件路径引用，打开编辑后仍显示蓝色文件名标签，可在前后输入文字或整项删除；提交和复制保留原始引用文本。没有可用的原生文件识别规则时保留普通文本，避免误识别或丢失内容。
- 移除附件**不删除电脑上的原文件**。
- Enter 直接发送，Shift+Enter 换行，Esc 取消；Ctrl/Cmd + Enter 仍可发送。中文输入法确认选字不会误发送，长按产生的重复按键不会重复提交。
- 纯文字、文字加附件、纯附件消息即使内容未改动，也可点击发送或按 Enter 重新生成，支持分支与当前对话两种模式。模型运行失败或成功结束后都可主动重发，无需修改文字或重新选择附件。
- 空消息、提交中、不可编辑时仍禁用发送。失败保留草稿；提交状态不确定时要求先刷新检查，避免重复运行。

dsh-inline-edit README · 文字与附件：使用 DSH 原生 SVG、主题颜色、字体和圆角。设置支持深色及窄窗口；保存失败时保留服务器已经接受的选项。设置读取失败会显示原因并提供「重试」，重新打开设置也会尝试恢复读取。服务未就绪或配置异常会单独提示，不再统一显示为会话尚未加载；读取到有效模式前仍禁止编辑，避免误用分支模式。

信息图标沿用 **DSH 原生提示框的样式和交互**，只显示「在当前对话重新生成」或「在新分支重新生成」，不附带说明段落。附件、模式及消息操作的短提示优先在对应按钮正下方居中，间距 8px。支持悬停、键盘聚焦；模式提示也可点击固定。详细规则保留在设置页面，模式在打开编辑框时固定。

较长的编辑限制说明位于按钮下方并与按钮右边对齐，不再推到整排时间和按钮的左侧。靠近窗口边缘时先水平调整，空间不足或挡住本消息内控件时再翻转；拥挤时保持提示可见并尽量减少遮挡。普通提示简化为「复制」「编辑」「添加附件」，完整无障碍标签保留；限制说明简化为「仅支持最近一条主消息；更早消息请使用分支模式」。

dsh-inline-edit README · 文字与附件：时间沿用原生规则：当天显示时分，其他日期带月日，跨年带年份，跨过午夜自动更新。悬停或用 Tab 聚焦时间可查看完整本地年月日和时分秒。鼠标复制后移开可收起工具栏，键盘复制保留焦点；复制失败仍显示错误。点击不可编辑的铅笔不追加重复文字；提交失败和结果不确定的提示会保留。

当前版本为 **0.3.0**。339 项自动回归、官方隔离 Web/Host 的离线验证、实际重启恢复及浏览器文件编辑验收已通过，发布前桌面实测也已确认通过。详细范围见 [验证记录](docs/VALIDATION.md)。

dsh-inline-edit README · 安装与升级：支持 **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1**，发布前桌面实测已确认通过。0.3.0 另在 Windows 的 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 官方 Web/Host** 中使用桌面安装包自带 CLI、独立配置与离线适配器验证，并完成真实 Host 重启后的会话恢复。rc.3 的 Web/Host 验证属于历史基线。真实外部模型、物理中文输入法、其他宿主版本和远程代理未纳入自动验收。

下载 [0.3.0 兼容性修订包](https://github.com/maxy1817/dsh-inline-edit/releases/tag/v0.3.0-compat.1)。包内版本仍为 0.3.0，修正 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 和 schemastery 3.19.0 的依赖声明；旧版 0.3.0 安装包未包含此修正。同版本重装不会自动提示升级。

在安装包目录执行：

~~~powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "./dsh-inline-edit-0.3.0-compat.tgz"
~~~

dsh-inline-edit README · 安装与升级：Web 配置把 desktop 改为 web。找不到 dsh 命令时，使用桌面安装目录下 resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd 的完整路径。重新打开 DSH，在设置中选择模式。预构建包无需安装开发依赖。

升级可安装新包；如提示已存在，先在插件管理中卸载旧包，再安装。默认仍为分支模式，不会自动修改已有聊天。

~~~powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-inline-edit
~~~

插件已收录到 [awesome-dsh-plugin 目录](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)。市场安装版本取决于目录中的安装包地址，更新合并并刷新索引后生效。尚未发布 npm，请使用 GitHub Release 附件或市场安装，见 [发布说明](docs/PUBLISHING.md)。

dsh-inline-edit README · 历史与边界：DSH 采用追加式日志。本插件使用公开 Session API 替换模型上下文，通过原生界面扩展过滤旧消息；**不改写或物理删除原日志**。旧内容可以在「轨迹」中审查，实际轮次和 Token 消耗继续保留。原生轮次导航仍以完整日志为准，可能包含已替换轮次。

停用插件后，原生聊天视图可能重显旧审计正文，但模型上下文仍采用已提交的替换；重新启用恢复过滤。不能将本功能视为隐私擦除。

**重新生成不会撤销已经执行的文件修改、命令、工具或外部操作。**

连续修改同一条消息时，旧版本的恢复记录也会退出活动上下文；从修改后的消息创建分支同样回退至其原始边界。编辑中断后如果已经出现新的用户输入，不再自动补发那次旧编辑。正常的更早对话继续保留。读取磁盘文件、轨迹或外部记忆的工具仍可能重新取得历史内容，本功能不清除这些外部状态。

其他限制：

dsh-inline-edit README · 历史与边界：- 已压缩且离开当前模型上下文的消息，不支持当前模式，请使用分支。
- 技能/会话引用、子智能体和非普通用户来源消息不重发，避免丢失语义。
- 最多 32 个附件；单个 64 MiB、合计 128 MiB、图片合计 20 MiB；仍受模型和 DSH 限制。
- 图片支持 PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF；其他文件使用原生上传。文本最多 20 万字符。
- 草稿仅在内存，刷新、切换会话或关闭程序后不保证恢复。
- 同时替换聊天 Flow/消息槽位的第三方插件需额外兼容测试。

dsh-inline-edit README · 开发：以下命令仅适用于完整源码仓库，不适用于解压后的预构建分发包。需要 Node.js 24.9+：

~~~sh
npm ci
npm run check
npm pack
~~~

随源码提交预构建 lib/ 和 .gitattributes。后者保留 src/style.css 的 CRLF 换行，使文本加载器生成的 CSS 字符串在不同平台与现有构建包一致。React 与 Host API 使用宿主模块。无安装脚本，不全局安装、不修改 PATH。

Host 走 DSH 已认证的 Connection，不另开端口。附件只接受可信原消息引用或目标会话上传收据；不能提交任意磁盘路径。当前模式有空闲锁、尾序号检查、请求去重和中断恢复。模型收到简短编辑说明及新问题，不会收到被替换的旧问答。

dsh-inline-edit README · 开发：MIT。独立第三方插件，与 DeepSeek、OpenAI 无隶属关系。[第三方声明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

dsh-inline-edit README · dsh-inline-edit：The editor's information icon retains DSH's native Tooltip styling and interactions and shows only “Regenerate in this conversation” or “Regenerate in a new branch.” Short hints for attachments, mode and message actions sit centered 8px below their own button. Hover and focus are supported; clicking the mode hint pins it. The mode is fixed when the editor opens; details remain in Settings.

dsh-inline-edit README · dsh-inline-edit：Long edit restrictions align with the button's right edge below it, rather than moving past the timestamp and the whole action row. Hints shift within viewport margins and flip sides when space or controls within the message require it. Crowded layouts keep hints visible with minimal overlap. The clock shows time today, month/day on other dates, and the year across years, updating at local midnight. Clicking an unavailable edit action adds no inline notice; submission failures and uncertain outcomes remain visible.

dsh-inline-edit README · dsh-inline-edit：Action hints use the concise “Copy,” “Edit” and “Attach files,” while accessible control labels retain their full wording. The latest-message restriction is shorter. Hovering or keyboard-focusing the clock reveals the full local date, year and time including seconds. Pointer copying releases button focus so the action row can hide when the pointer leaves; keyboard copying keeps focus. Clipboard errors remain visible.

dsh-inline-edit README · dsh-inline-edit：Current version: **0.3.0**. All 339 automated regressions, isolated official Web/Host checks with an offline provider, recovery after a real Host restart, and browser file-editing acceptance have passed. Desktop testing was also confirmed before release. See [Validation](docs/VALIDATION.md) for the exact scope.

Native inline message editing for DeepSeek Harness. Change text, attachments, or both, with Cancel and Send buttons, native icons and theme tokens.

dsh-inline-edit README · Modes：Choose **Settings → Message editing**. Settings persist in the active DSH profile.

Failed settings reads show an explicit Retry action; reopening Settings also attempts recovery. Unavailable services and invalid settings have distinct messages instead of being reported as an unfinished session. Editing stays blocked until a valid mode is received.

dsh-inline-edit README · Modes：- **Create a branch** (default): preserve the source conversation and continue in a new chat.
- **Regenerate in this conversation**: edit only the **latest main message submitted while idle to start a task**. Retain the Session ID and sidebar chat. Later supplemental input and answers are replaced.

dsh-inline-edit README · Modes：Steering and queued input submitted during generation are excluded, even when later processed as a separate turn. The UI hides their edit button and the Host rejects edits. Earlier main messages require branch mode. Wait for generation and the pending queue to finish. DSH's built-in pending-queue editor is unchanged.

dsh-inline-edit README · Installation：Supports **DSH 0.2.2-rc.1**, with desktop testing confirmed before release. Version 0.3.0 was also tested with **DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 official Web/Host on Windows**, using the desktop installation's CLI, an isolated configuration and an offline provider, including session recovery after a real Host restart. The rc.3 Web/Host checks are historical baselines. Real model providers, a physical Chinese IME, other host releases and reverse proxies were not part of automated acceptance.

dsh-inline-edit README · Installation：Download the [0.3.0 compatibility revision](https://github.com/maxy1817/dsh-inline-edit/releases/tag/v0.3.0-compat.1). Its package version remains 0.3.0; it corrects the declarations for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 and schemastery 3.19.0. The original 0.3.0 asset does not contain this fix. Reinstalling the same version does not provide an automatic upgrade notification.

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-inline-edit-0.3.0-compat.tgz
~~~

dsh-inline-edit README · Installation：Use web instead of desktop for a Web profile. If dsh is not on PATH, use the full path to resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd inside the desktop installation. Restart DSH. The plugin is listed in the [awesome-dsh-plugin catalog](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin); marketplace versions follow its tarball URL after an update is merged and the index refreshes. It is not published to npm. Install from a GitHub Release asset or a marketplace.

dsh-inline-edit README · Installation：~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-inline-edit
~~~

dsh-inline-edit README · Behavior：Text-only messages, text with attachments, and attachment-only messages can be resent unchanged in either mode using Send or Enter, after either a failed or successful model run. Shift+Enter inserts a newline; Ctrl/Cmd + Enter still sends, and Esc cancels. IME confirmation and repeated keydown events do not submit. No text changes or attachment replacement are needed. Empty messages, busy sessions and uncertain submissions remain blocked.

dsh-inline-edit README · Behavior：Text-only edits retain attachments. Attachment-only edits can add, remove or replace files. Picking, dropping, pasting, IME, shortcuts and duplicate-send protection are supported. Removing attachments does not delete disk originals. Cancel restores the draft; errors preserve changes.

dsh-inline-edit README · Behavior：Retained and newly selected ordinary files appear as native blue atomic labels in the same text flow, without an added delete X. Type before, between or after files. Picking files preserves the previous caret position and leaves the caret immediately after the new labels, ready for more text without adding spaces. Backspace, Delete or cutting a selection removes a whole file token; Undo restores the real attachment. Submission retains the original attachment reference or new file contents, and display names do not become body text.

dsh-inline-edit README · Behavior：File mentions recognized by DSH also retain blue labels inside the editor; their original paths, quotes and surrounding text remain the submission and clipboard representation. Missing native recognition falls back to plain text.

dsh-inline-edit README · Behavior：Messages with no non-whitespace text hide the Copy action. Messages with text copy the full text, preserving spaces and line breaks even when attachments are present. Clicking a retained or newly added image thumbnail opens DSH's native image preview. Escape, the backdrop and Close return to editing with the draft and attachments intact; preview failures leave the filename and Remove action available.

dsh-inline-edit README · Behavior：Opening the editor, growing text and changing attachments expand upward by compensating conversation scrolling; cancellation keeps the following answer in place as well. Compensation respects available scroll space and manual scrolling, without overlapping earlier messages.

dsh-inline-edit README · Behavior：Current mode uses a logged surface replacement, not rewriting or deleting session files. Old content remains auditable in Trace; usage counters and native turn navigation retain historical turns. Navigation can include superseded content. Disabling the plugin can show old audit content again without restoring the old model context. A short edit-context notice accompanies the replacement.

Regeneration does not undo file changes, commands or external actions.

dsh-inline-edit README · Behavior：Repeated edits remove superseded recovery payloads from the active message surface as well. Branching from an edited replacement uses its original boundary. An interrupted edit is not automatically replayed after newer user input. Earlier valid conversation remains; tools can still read historical content from files, Trace or external memory.

dsh-inline-edit README · Behavior：Limits: 32 attachments, 64 MiB each, 128 MiB total, 20 MiB images, 200,000 characters. Skills/session references, busy/queued sessions and subagents are refused. Compacted messages require branches. Drafts are memory-only. Other chat-slot replacements may conflict.

dsh-inline-edit README · Development：From the source repository (not an unpacked distribution tarball), with Node.js 24.9+:

~~~sh
npm ci
npm run check
npm pack
~~~

Commit prebuilt lib/ and .gitattributes. The latter preserves CRLF in src/style.css so its embedded text-loader output matches the existing bundle on different platforms. DSH provides Host packages and React. No install hooks, private React access, session-file rewriting, telemetry or external model requests are added.
